P05.notes: Finite 19-entry English PTT dictionary (5 controls), optional spoken musico, bounded BuildConfig threshold and fail-closed absent confidence; no tests/build/Actions.

P06.notes: P06 typed Voice dispatch, service ACK correlation, existing bounded idempotency reuse, voice-only safe NEXT-at-end/no-queue and blocked PLAY; code committed but NO Gradle/test/Actions.

P07.notes: P07 source-only Media3 service lease, 0.25 volume multiplier, 22s TTL, caller-private commands, pre-STT ack, fail/terminal cancellation/focus/route release; no build/tests.

P08.notes: P08 8 localizable English single-sentence feedback messages; 5 success only after Media3 ACK, optional final failure speech, retryable silence, one-shot gen gate and 2s max TTS; source-only no Gradle/test/Actions.

P09.notes: P09 pure WF-08 shared status projection; one accessible Compose Voice panel reused by Full Player and Driving, 21 string resources, focus-return, truthful retry/dismiss/manual paths. Source only: no build, Tests or Actions.

P10.notes: P10 foreground-only Voice; atomic rapid-tap block, provider recognizer/utterance cancellation identity, app-stop/revoked permission, focus and BT route, bounded un-Duck controller drain. No Build, JUnit, Actions.

P11.notes: P11 transcript redaction in result toString, stricter future cloud disclosure, 4 typed local Voice diagnostics, 7 privacy strings in Settings, nonpersistent NoOp sink and networkless production boundary audited. No Build/JUnit/Actions.

P12.notes: P12 cumulative P00-P11 and Issue7/8/9 static review, source F12-01 voice receipt process-namespace hardening and F12-02 Compose heading rename, 15 authored-only JUnit methods, 16 AC traced, 50 lab cases prepared NOT_RUN; no build, CI, phone QA or APK.

deferred_carryover.expected_retest: Issue #9 M45: parked Driving -> explicit Mic -> English 'Next song' -> exactly one Media3 NEXT
deferred_carryover.not_to_be_confused_with_issue10_M45: Issue #10 M45 refers to background/cancellation; different checklist.

privacy.policy: Never put private audio/transcripts/music paths/Bluetooth MAC/call identity in evidence or telemetry

implemented_source_boundaries: one shared permission gate and OS launcher
origin-specific cancel and no automatic start after permission callback

remaining: P13 cumulative build and owner QA

P05.confidence_policy: BuildConfig default=0.90, bounds=0.80..0.98, null/invalid/low fails closed; unknown/artist rejected
remaining: P06 Media3 single command ACK and service idempotency

P06.media3_ack: command_ack_id must equal voice CommandId on successful SessionResult
P06.existing_service_dedup: PlaybackCommandProcessor with bounded 256 receipt ledger; same ID same payload shares Deferred, conflicting ID rejects
known_limits: Media3 ACK is accepted command, not proof of immediately audible output

safety_limitations: TTL best effort inside alive service
service controller detach may lose release, TTL owns fallback
late in-flight acquire/release and OEM volume/focus race requires P10/P13 scrutiny

P08.provider: Android installed English offline voice only; optional
P08.catalog: 8 stable resource keys with Android strings.xml, pure English JVM fallback
remaining: P09 WF-08 screen/a11y and visual copy

P09.model: VoiceSessionState + VoicePracticeStage only; UI does not own recording/playback
P09.displayed_microphone_claim: Preparing or listening because duck ACK precedes STT
a11y: Focus restore only on panel open/close

P10.foreground_lease: Activity onStart/onStop in-memory, blocks post-stop Mic and Retry
limitations: service packet might not arrive; TTL best effort

P11.voice_transcript: Ephemeral in-memory result; toString redacted; no history/DB or app-owned network upload
P11.manifest: no INTERNET; backup disabled; RECORD_AUDIO JIT
P11.production_cloud: remoteAdapterApproved=false and legalApproval=false; stale consent cannot authorize
limitations: OEM recognition engine and logcat privacy not verified
Merged manifest, device network/backup checks not run
Cloud legal/processor terms require future review
